findings.summary: Corvane-DST achieves higher mean JGA than Halloway-DST on the Merriwold-Dialog 2.0 test set (56.8% vs 56.1%), but no statistical test is reported for this comparison, so the difference is not established as significant.
findings.caveats: No significance test reported for this specific comparison.

findings.summary: Corvane-DST significantly outperforms Pipkin-Span on the Merriwold-Dialog 2.0 test set (mean difference 4.5 percentage points, 95% CI [3.51, 5.5], p < 0.001).
On the Tarnby-Schema test set (unseen services), Corvane-DST significantly outperforms Halloway-DST in JGA (mean difference 2.3 percentage points, 95% CI [1.18, 3.42], p = 0.0046).
findings.caveats: Services unseen in training; secondary evaluation.

findings.summary: Per-domain JGA on single-domain Merriwold-Dialog 2.0 test dialogues shows mixed results: Corvane-DST is higher in train, restaurant, and attraction, but lower in hotel and taxi compared to Halloway-DST.
findings.scope: Single-domain Merriwold-Dialog 2.0 test dialogues, JGA per domain, 5 seeds
findings.caveats: No significance tests reported; small taxi domain (61 dialogues).

findings.summary: Ablation shows both components contribute to Corvane-DST's JGA: removing slot descriptions reduces JGA from 56.8% to 54.9%, removing history compression reduces it to 55.7%, and removing both reduces it to 53.6%.
findings.caveats: No significance tests reported for ablation differences.
